name: Manage a grocery list from a self-hosted web app

parameters.query: SELECT id, item, quantity, category, store, checked, added_by, created_at, checked_at FROM grocery_items WHERE ($1 = '' OR store ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%') ORDER BY checked ASC, CASE WHEN checked THEN checked_at ELSE created_at END DESC
INSERT INTO grocery_items (item, quantity, category, store, added_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id, item, quantity, category, store, checked, added_by, created_at
UPDATE grocery_items SET checked = TRUE, checked_at = now() WHERE ($1::int IS NOT NULL AND id = $1::int) RETURNING id, item, quantity, category, checked, added_by, created_at

parameters.content:
### Manage a grocery list from a self-hosted web app
A mobile-friendly grocery list you host yourself in n8n. No login, no app to install, just a webpage you can bookmark on your phone. Pick one of three storage backends: n8n Data Tables (zero setup), Postgres, or Google Sheets.

### How it works
Three webhooks make up the whole app: one serves the list as an HTML page, one adds an item, one checks an item off. Adding or checking off an item redirects back to the list, so it behaves like a plain web form. No JavaScript framework required. Only the backend you enable runs; the other two stay disabled.

### Setup
1. Pick a backend in the sections below (Data Tables needs zero setup).
2. Run the Setup trigger once to create storage automatically.
3. Activate the workflow, then open the View List (GET) node and copy its Production URL.

### Customization
Add fields to the form, restyle the inline CSS, or add Basic Auth in front of the webhooks. There's no login by default, so anyone with the link can view or edit the list.

## Postgres backend (optional)
Bring your own database. Select your Postgres credential on these nodes, then run Setup once to create the table.

## Data Tables backend (default)
No account needed, already enabled. Run Setup once to create the grocery_items table automatically.

nodes.name: ▶ Click "Execute Workflow" to Set Up Storage

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grocery_items (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  item TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  store TEXT,
  checked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  added_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

parameters.content:
## One-time setup
Run the trigger once. Only your enabled backend runs; the other two are skipped, no error. Safe to run again.

Check row 1 has clean headers after Setup: item, quantity, category, store, checked, added_by. If Sheets: Add Item or Check Off Item show empty field mappings, re-enter them manually.
